inv.desc_en: Buyer exempt from additional fees. With 21m² and in the heart of Zaragoza, just a five-minute walk from Plaza del Pilar and a five-minute walk from Plaza España and the tram. Close to all services: pharmacies, shops, supermarkets, restaurants, cinemas, local stores, and a health center. Excellent opportunity for an investor. The building was constructed in 1941 and has passed the ITE (technical building inspection), with all tests successfully completed. It is in excellent condition, and the facade was recently painted. It is currently used as a storage room, although the deed lists it as a former garage, which allows it to be used as such. It has plenty of storage space, as it has 21 m² of surface area and a bathroom. The premises have water and electricity. The neighborhood is characterized by its artisanal, artistic, and bohemian people. A premises, storage room, or garage within your reach in the heart of Zaragoza. If you want to see it, schedule a visit and I will show it to you. We will find the financing you need [IW].
inv.title_en: Commercial premises for sale in Calle de la Torre
